Algorithm:
- Initialize swap index as pivot index
- Iterate from pivot_index+1 to end_index+1 to check:
- If current ele is less than pivot ele:
- Incr swap index and swap curr ele with swap ele.
- Swap pivot ele with swap ele.
- Return swap index.

- If left index is less than right index, proceed partitioning:
- Call pivot func to partition list around pivot ele and get new pivot index.
- Recursively call itself on sublist to left of pivot.
- Recursively call itself on sublist to right of pivot.
- Return sorted list.
Time & Space Complexity:
Time - 
Best and Average case: O(n logn)
Worst case: O(n^2)
Space -
Best and Average case: O(logn)
Worst case: O(n)
